ex.es: Todo el pueblo se unió después de la inundación.

ex.en: If we all [pull together], we can meet the deadline.
ex.es: Si todos jalamos parejo, podemos cumplir con la fecha.

def: to decide to do or spend less than before
note: Pull back on + gasto. También de noticias: stocks pulled back.

ex.en: Many shoppers are [pulling back] on big purchases.
ex.es: Muchos compradores están gastando menos en compras grandes.

ex.en: The company [pulled back] from its plans to expand.
ex.es: La empresa se echó para atrás con sus planes de expansión.

def: to make someone feel excited and full of energy
note: Informal. I'm pumped (up) = estoy muy emocionado. Separable.

ex.en: The coach's speech really [pumped up] the team.
ex.es: El discurso del entrenador prendió muchísimo al equipo.

ex.en: This playlist always [pumps me up] before a workout.
ex.es: Esta playlist siempre me prende antes de hacer ejercicio.

def: to change a meeting or date to a later time
note: Separable: push it back. Lo contrario: move up.

ex.en: Can we [push back] our call to three thirty?
ex.es: ¿Podemos recorrer la llamada a las tres y media?

ex.en: The release was [pushed back] to next spring.
ex.es: El lanzamiento se pospuso para la próxima primavera.

def: to say that you do not agree with a plan or request
note: Push back on/against + idea. Sustantivo: pushback = resistencia.

ex.en: The team [pushed back] on the new deadline.
ex.es: El equipo puso objeciones a la nueva fecha de entrega.

ex.en: Don't be afraid to [push back] if the request is unfair.
ex.es: No tengas miedo de oponerte si lo que piden es injusto.

es: aguantar y seguir (pese al cansancio o dolor)
def: to continue doing something even when it is hard or painful

ex.en: I was exhausted, but I [pushed through] the last mile.
ex.es: Estaba exhausto, pero aguanté y terminé el último kilómetro y medio.

ex.en: She [pushed through] the pain and finished her shift.
ex.es: Aguantó el dolor y terminó su turno.

def: to try hard to make something happen by asking many times
note: Inseparable.

ex.en: The union is [pushing for] a ten percent raise.
ex.es: El sindicato está presionando por un aumento del diez por ciento.

ex.en: Parents [pushed for] a crosswalk near the school.
ex.es: Los papás presionaron para que pusieran un cruce peatonal cerca de la escuela.

def: to tell someone what to do in a rude or unfair way
note: El objeto va en medio: push people around.

ex.en: Don't let your coworkers [push you around].
ex.es: No dejes que tus compañeros te mangoneen.

ex.en: He [pushes around] the new guys because he can.
ex.es: Mangonea a los nuevos porque puede.

def: to place clothes or other things on your body
note: Separable: put it on. Put on = acción de ponerse; wear = traer puesto.

ex.en: [Put on] a jacket, it's freezing outside.
ex.es: Ponte una chamarra, afuera está helando.

ex.en: She [put on] her glasses to read the menu.
ex.es: Se puso los lentes para leer el menú.

def: to become heavier
note: Casi siempre con weight o una cantidad: put on five pounds.

ex.en: I [put on] a few pounds over the holidays.
ex.es: Subí unos kilitos en las fiestas.

ex.en: He's trying to [put on] weight for football season.
ex.es: Está tratando de subir de peso para la temporada de futbol americano.

def: to make music, a film or a device start playing
note: Separable: put it on.

ex.en: Let's [put on] some music while we cook.
ex.es: Hay que poner algo de música mientras cocinamos.

ex.en: Dad [put on] the game as soon as he got home.
ex.es: Mi papá puso el partido en cuanto llegó a la casa.

def: to decide to do something at a later time
note: Separable: put it off. Va con -ing: put off going.

ex.en: I keep [putting off] going to the dentist.
ex.es: Sigo posponiendo lo de ir al dentista.

ex.en: We [put off] the trip until the kids finish school.
ex.es: Dejamos el viaje para cuando los niños salgan de la escuela.

es: quitarle las ganas a; caer mal
def: to make someone not like or not want something
note: El objeto va en medio: it put me off. I was put off by... = me sacó de onda...

ex.en: The smell of the kitchen [put me off] the restaurant.
ex.es: El olor de la cocina me quitó las ganas de ese restaurante.

ex.en: Don't be [put off] by his serious face, he's very kind.
ex.es: Que no te saque de onda su cara seria, es muy buena gente.

def: to accept something annoying without complaining
note: Inseparable.

ex.en: I can't [put up with] this noise any longer.
ex.es: Ya no aguanto este ruido.

ex.en: She [puts up with] a two-hour commute every day.
ex.es: Se aguanta dos horas de traslado todos los días.

es: poner; colgar (en la pared, a la vista)
def: to fix something on a wall or in a place where people can see it
note: Separable: put it up. Put up a poster / a sign / decorations.

ex.en: We [put up] the Christmas lights last weekend.
ex.es: Pusimos las luces de Navidad el fin de semana pasado.

ex.en: Someone [put up] a sign about a lost cat.
ex.es: Alguien pegó un letrero de un gato perdido.

def: to let someone stay in your home for a short time
note: El objeto va en medio: put me up for the night.

ex.en: My aunt [put us up] for a week in Ottawa.
ex.es: Mi tía nos hospedó una semana en Ottawa.

ex.en: Can you [put me up] for the night? My flight got canceled.
ex.es: ¿Me puedo quedar en tu casa hoy? Cancelaron mi vuelo.

def: to place something where it is usually kept
note: Separable: put it away.

ex.en: Please [put away] your phone during dinner.
ex.es: Por favor guarda tu cel durante la cena.

ex.en: I washed the dishes and he [put away] the groceries.
ex.es: Yo lavé los trastes y él guardó el mandado.

def: to return something to the place where it was before
note: Separable: put it back.

ex.en: [Put back] the milk in the fridge when you're done.
ex.es: Regresa la leche al refri cuando acabes.

ex.en: She looked at the price and [put back] the shoes.
ex.es: Vio el precio y regresó los zapatos a su lugar.

def: to place something you are holding on a table or the floor
note: Separable: put it down. I couldn't put it down = no podía dejar de leerlo.

ex.en: [Put down] your bags and come have something to eat.
ex.es: Deja tus maletas y ven a comer algo.

ex.en: The book was so good I couldn't [put it down].
ex.es: El libro estaba tan bueno que no lo podía soltar.

def: to say things that make someone feel stupid or small
note: Separable. Sustantivo: a put-down = comentario hiriente.

ex.en: He's always [putting down] his wife in front of people.
ex.es: Siempre anda haciendo menos a su esposa enfrente de la gente.

ex.en: Stop [putting yourself down], your English is great.
ex.es: Deja de hacerte menos, tu inglés es muy bueno.

def: to pay the first part of the cost of something
note: Separable. Down payment = enganche.

ex.en: We [put down] twenty percent on the house.
ex.es: Dimos el veinte por ciento de enganche para la casa.

ex.en: You have to [put down] a deposit to hold the room.
ex.es: Tienes que dar un anticipo para apartar el cuarto.

def: to make a fire or something that is burning stop
note: Separable: put it out. Para luces y aparatos se usa turn off.

ex.en: Firefighters [put out] the fire in under an hour.
ex.es: Los bomberos apagaron el incendio en menos de una hora.

ex.en: Make sure you [put out] the campfire before bed.
ex.es: Asegúrate de apagar la fogata antes de dormir.

def: to make something like music, a product or news ready for the public
note: Separable: put it out.

ex.en: The band is [putting out] a new album in June.
ex.es: La banda va a sacar un disco nuevo en junio.

ex.en: The company [put out] a statement about the data leak.
ex.es: La empresa publicó un comunicado sobre la filtración de datos.

def: to make something by joining its parts or collecting ideas
note: Separable: put it together.

ex.en: It took me three hours to [put together] that bookshelf.
ex.es: Me tardé tres horas en armar ese librero.

ex.en: I'll [put together] a quick summary for the client.
ex.es: Le preparo un resumen rápido al cliente.

def: to spend time or effort doing something
note: Separable. Put in the work / the hours / the effort.

ex.en: She [put in] a lot of hours to finish the project.
ex.es: Le dedicó muchísimas horas a terminar el proyecto.

ex.en: If you [put in] the effort, you'll see results.
ex.es: Si le echas ganas, vas a ver resultados.

def: to fix new equipment or furniture in place so it can be used
note: Separable: put it in.

ex.en: We're [putting in] a new kitchen next month.
ex.es: Vamos a instalar una cocina nueva el próximo mes.

ex.en: The landlord [put in] better windows before winter.
ex.es: El casero mandó poner mejores ventanas antes del invierno.

def: to ask for something in an official way at work
note: Inseparable. Put in for a transfer / vacation / a raise.

ex.en: I [put in for] two weeks of vacation in August.
ex.es: Solicité dos semanas de vacaciones en agosto.

ex.en: He's [putting in for] a transfer to the Vancouver office.
ex.es: Está solicitando su cambio a la oficina de Vancouver.

def: to offer an idea or plan for other people to discuss
note: Separable. Algo formal.

ex.en: She [put forward] a plan to cut costs by ten percent.
ex.es: Propuso un plan para reducir costos en diez por ciento.

ex.en: Several solutions were [put forward] at the meeting.
ex.es: En la junta se presentaron varias soluciones.

def: to connect a caller to the person they want to speak to
note: El objeto va en medio: I'll put you through.

ex.en: One moment, I'll [put you through] to billing.
ex.es: Un momento, lo comunico con facturación.

ex.en: The operator [put me through] to the wrong department.
ex.es: La operadora me pasó al departamento equivocado.

def: to make someone experience something very hard or painful
note: El objeto va en medio: put her through a lot.

ex.en: I'm sorry for everything I [put you through] last year.
ex.es: Perdóname por todo lo que te hice pasar el año pasado.

ex.en: The new hires are [put through] a tough training program.
ex.es: A los nuevos los hacen pasar por una capacitación muy pesada.

def: to save money or time for a special purpose
note: Separable. También: put aside your differences = dejar de lado.

ex.en: I [put aside] a little money every month for emergencies.
ex.es: Aparto un poco de dinero cada mes para emergencias.

ex.en: Try to [put aside] an hour a day to practice.
ex.es: Trata de apartar una hora al día para practicar.

es: incitar a; meterle la idea de
def: to tell someone to do something silly or wrong
note: El objeto va en medio: Who put you up to this?

ex.en: Who [put you up to] this prank? Was it your brother?
ex.es: ¿Quién te metió la idea de esta broma? ¿Fue tu hermano?

ex.en: I think his friends [put him up to] it.
ex.es: Creo que sus amigos lo incitaron a hacerlo.
